falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4200 at any point in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 76% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug, as that bottom held at ~4400 and the structure would be violated by lower lows

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 41 suggests elevated but contained stress; sustained VIX >35 indicates panic escalation inconsistent with a bottom formation and signals a breakdown rather than stabilization

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts further below -50bps (more negative)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion would signal worsening economic conditions/recession acceleration, contradicting the bottoming thesis which requires stabilization or steepening of the yield curve

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
